name: Remove Shadow Master AI flee routine
description: Port of the 2.4 patch at 3F9BD0 to D2R 3.3 (D2RLoader 1.3.0 image). ShadowMaster and ShadowMasterNoInit (normal AI table at RVA 0x2396E90, entries 106 and 143; no other entry uses it) share the think function at RVA 0x5CD740. After its target scan (callback 0x5D1360) it counts nearby units and, when the count is above 3, rolls (rng & 0x1F) < 2 * count. On success it either runs back to its owner (0x4A74A0, mode 15, when the owner is more than 36 away) or moves away from its target (0x4A7320, distance 8). This patch turns the count gate into an unconditional skip, so the retreat never runs and the AI always continues to its normal skill and attack selection.

patches.description: Gate 'cmp edx,3 / jle 0x5CDEC4' at 0x5CDE51. Only the byte at 0x5CDE54 changes, 7E (jle) to EB (jmp), so the displacement 0x6E and the target 0x5CDEC4 stay the same. The cmp is written back unchanged so the loader verifies the whole gate before patching. 0x5CDEC4 is where the stock code already goes with 3 or fewer nearby units; the skipped block only advances the unit's RNG and makes the two movement calls, so nothing after it depends on it.
